Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - S.C.C. No. 2814/2023

Dear Mr. Bhatt,

Thank you for meeting us on 29 July 2023 about your dispute with M/s Rathore Enterprises. As we understand it, the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match.

Our advice is to obtain the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and treat it as a dishonour under the cheque-bounce law. Please collect the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and the drawer's earlier cheques and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
